StringProperty.Name: ConfigurationFile
StringProperty.Description: Specify an XML file that overrides the project XEX configuration settings.

StringProperty.Name: TitleID
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the title ID of the application.

StringProperty.Name: LanKey
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the key used for system link. (For testing purposes only. Final LAN Key is set at submission time.)

BoolProperty.Name: SuppressStartupBanner
BoolProperty.Description: Suppress the display of the startup banner and information messages. (/nologo)

StringProperty.Name: BaseAddress
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the base address of the image when loaded.

StringProperty.Name: HeapSize
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the size of the default process heap created at process startup.

StringProperty.Name: WorkspaceSize
StringProperty.Description: Specifies the size of the memory workspace for enumerators and other system processes.

StringListProperty.Name: AdditionalSections
StringListProperty.Description: Adds binary resource files to the produced XEX image with section headers.

BoolProperty.Name: ExportByName
BoolProperty.Description: Specifies whether symbol names are to be included in the executable.

BoolProperty.Name: OpticalDiscDriveMapping
BoolProperty.Description: Does not map the optical disc drive to CdRom0:\\.

BoolProperty.Name: Pal50Incompatible
BoolProperty.Description: Specifies that the title does not support PAL50.

BoolProperty.Name: MultiDiscTitle
BoolProperty.Description: Enables system support for a multi-disc title.

BoolProperty.Name: PreferBigButtonInput
BoolProperty.Description: Modifies system notifications for game controller removal.

BoolProperty.Name: CrossPlatformSystemLink
BoolProperty.Description: Indicates the title will use IP addressing for System Link instead of Ethernet addressing.

BoolProperty.Name: AllowAvatarGetMetadata
BoolProperty.DisplayName: Allow Avatar Get Metadata By XUID
BoolProperty.Description: Indicates the title is allowed to call XAvatarGetMetadataByXuid in order to get a collection of LIVE user's XAVATAR_METADATA blobs.

BoolProperty.Name: AllowControllerSwapping
BoolProperty.Description: Allows a title to swap the users from one controller to another with XInputRemap.

BoolProperty.Name: RequireFullExperience
BoolProperty.Description: Indicates the title requires the extended Xbox LIVE experience (as launched in the Fall 2008 NXE).

BoolProperty.Name: GameVoiceRequiredUI
BoolProperty.Description: Allows the title to call XShowRequiredGameVoiceChannelUI, which informs the user the title requires them to switch to the game voice channel.

BoolProperty.Name: KinectElevationControl
BoolProperty.Description: Allows a title to successfully call NuiCameraElevationSetAngle.

EnumProperty.Description.sys:String: This property indicates whether the title requires skeletal tracking.
